{{Quote|The desperate Sith, leaving their collective destiny to chance, chose to forgo all known hyperspace routes and attempt a series of dangerously random hyperspace jumps and blind scouting missions. For 20 years the Sith armada drifted aimlessly in the forgotten regions of space before finally rediscovering the Dromund system.|A dossier on Dromund Kaas|<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|dromund-kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a number of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fled the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] in a mass '''exodus''' led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. The exodus allowed for the survival of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] and the birth of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Sith Empire]]. However, Vitiate had in fact known the location of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], a lost colony of the old Empire, the entire time, and the true purpose of the twenty-year exodus was to build his people's devotion to him and make them dependent upon his wisdom and guidance.<ref name="Revan" />
